changes.en: New: background preparation of Clean up — while the PC is idle, plugged in and not running a full-screen game or presentation, DeskTrace reads your drives at the lowest priority (at most every 12 hours), so Clean up opens on fresh results; can be switched off in Settings
changes.zh: 新功能：在后台预先准备“空间清理”——电脑空闲、接通电源且没有运行全屏游戏或演示时，桌迹以最低优先级读取你的磁盘（最多每 12 小时一次），打开“空间清理”时结果已经是新的；可在设置中关闭

changes.en: New: first-run guide — three short, skippable steps: what to watch (and how DeskTrace differs from File History, "Previous versions" and OneDrive), protection starting, and one real undo with a test file DeskTrace makes and deletes itself
changes.zh: 新功能：入门向导——三个可跳过的简短步骤：选择监控的文件夹（并说明桌迹与文件历史记录、“以前的版本”、OneDrive 的区别）、开始保护，以及用桌迹自己创建并删除的测试文件实际恢复一次

changes.en: Reading a drive is much faster: a full read of a 1.9-million-file system drive takes about 50 seconds instead of 80–130, using several processes while you wait (spinning disks and background reads stay gentle, one folder at a time)
changes.zh: 读取磁盘快了很多：完整读取一个有 190 万个文件的系统盘约需 50 秒，而不是 80–130 秒——你等待时使用多个进程并行读取（机械硬盘和后台读取仍然一次一个文件夹，保持温和）

changes.en: Clean up opens at once on the last scan, which is kept on disk (checked against the disk's serial number, so a different disk is read again); quick scan (your folders only) or full scan; spinning disks start with a quick scan
changes.zh: “空间清理”会立即显示保存在磁盘上的上次扫描结果（会核对磁盘序列号，换了磁盘会重新读取）；可选择快速扫描（只读取你的文件夹）或完整扫描；机械硬盘默认快速扫描

changes.en: Kept versions are compressed: text, documents in plain formats and code take about 90% less room; Office files, PDFs, pictures and archives are left as they are; versions kept by older versions stay readable and are compressed gradually during upkeep
changes.zh: 保存的版本会被压缩：文本、纯文本格式文档和代码占用的空间减少约 90%；Office 文件、PDF、图片和压缩包保持原样；旧版本保存的版本依然可读，并会在定期维护时逐步压缩

changes.en: Clean up shows what files really take on the disk: whole clusters, less when compressed, much less when sparse; files Windows keeps hard-linked in WinSxS are counted once (9.4 GB less on the test PC), and the size is shown next to it
changes.zh: “空间清理”显示文件在磁盘上的实际占用：按簇对齐，压缩文件更小，稀疏文件小得多；WinSxS 中 Windows 硬链接的文件只计一次（测试电脑上少算了 9.4 GB），并同时显示文件大小

changes.en: Undo for 10 seconds after anything was moved to the Recycle Bin — one file or a whole cleaning run; an occupied original place is never overwritten
changes.zh: 移到回收站后 10 秒内可以撤销——无论是单个文件还是一次清理；原位置已被占用时绝不覆盖

changes.en: Chat apps: WeChat, QQ, WeCom, DingTalk and Telegram data is shown with its size and how to clean it inside the app, with buttons to open the app or its data folder; DeskTrace never deletes chat data
changes.zh: 聊天应用：显示微信、QQ、企业微信、钉钉和 Telegram 数据的大小以及在应用内清理的方法，并提供打开应用或数据文件夹的按钮；桌迹绝不删除聊天数据

changes.en: Hibernation: Clean up shows what hiberfil.sys takes and can switch hibernation off (or on again) — Windows asks for permission itself; DeskTrace never runs as administrator
changes.zh: 休眠：“空间清理”显示 hiberfil.sys 的占用，并可关闭（或重新打开）休眠——由 Windows 自己请求许可；桌迹从不以管理员身份运行

changes.en: Simpler: Statistics was removed (its tab, the tray entry and the I shortcut)
changes.zh: 更简洁：删除了“统计”（其标签页、托盘菜单项和 I 快捷键）

changes.en: Clean up: the scan line says when the shown results were made, and whether they are a quick or a full scan
changes.zh: 空间清理：扫描行会注明当前结果的扫描时间，以及是快速扫描还是完整扫描
